# TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors — facts

> Source-anchored units about TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors: 16 across 5 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] A single insert that generates many index entries can create enough dirty transaction state to enter repeated eviction rollbacks. SERVER-61909 reproduces this with a text index and a 256 MB cache; the problem is not restricted to explicit multi-document transactions. (high confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-61909 · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-3223
- [statement] transactionTooLargeForCacheThreshold defaults to 0.75 of dirty cache. With the documented 20% dirty-cache budget, the illustrative retry boundary is 15% of total cache. It applies after a cache-pressure rollback, not as an unconditional transaction-size cap. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-3223

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] TemporarilyUnavailable can signal repeated storage-engine rollbacks under cache pressure. The failed operation may have caused the pressure or merely suffered from it; the error does not identify which. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
- [statement] Outside multi-document transactions, MongoDB bounds internal TemporarilyUnavailable retries with temporarilyUnavailableMaxRetries and increases delay using temporarilyUnavailableBackoffBaseMs. Exhausted retries expose the error to the client. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md
- [statement] With the parameter reference's documented 20% dirty-cache limit, multiplying by the 0.75 retry threshold gives 15% of total cache. That conditional calculation does not mean transactions always fail upon occupying 15% of cache. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-3223
- [statement] SERVER-84007 describes a heuristic blind spot: rollback at the update-bytes limit may miss the dirty-pages test and yield WriteConflict or TemporarilyUnavailable, allowing futile retries. The issue was unresolved in its June 12, 2026 update. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-12) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-84007 · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors
- [statement] temporarilyUnavailableErrors appears in slow-query logging and FTDC, providing evidence of internally encountered cache-pressure errors even when retries eventually succeed. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md
- [statement] MongoDB assigns error code 365 to TemporarilyUnavailable and 388 to TransactionTooLargeForCache. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/base/error_codes.yml · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] In the ordinary write-conflict retry path, operations inside multi-document transactions return WriteConflict rather than exposing TemporarilyUnavailable; this describes that handler, not every possible transaction-abort mechanism. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
- [statement] The parameter reference lists temporarilyUnavailableMaxRetries with default 10; the storage guide describes bounded retries rather than the indefinite WriteConflict retry loop. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md
- [statement] For cache-error diagnosis, correlate the temporarilyUnavailableErrors counter in slow logs and FTDC with cache usage, dirty pages and eviction activity. Percona PMM exposes these cache metrics; this correlation is diagnostic context rather than proof of the failing transaction's size. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-monitoring-and-management/3/reference/dashboards/dashboard-mongodb-wiredtiger-details.html

## Facts and statements

- [statement] TransactionTooLargeForCache identifies a cache-pressure rollback that a heuristic judges unlikely to succeed even without concurrent operations; repeating the unchanged transaction is therefore unlikely to help. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/transactions-in-applications.md, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-3223
- [statement] The documented default transactionTooLargeForCacheThreshold is 0.75 of dirty cache, evaluated after a cache-pressure rollback. This is a retry heuristic, not an unconditional hard cap on transaction size; setting it to 1.0 disables the check. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-3223
- [statement] The application guide documents TransactionTooLargeForCache as new in MongoDB 6.2 and says the server does not retry it. The storage README instead says prior to 6.3; use release-specific evidence before asserting the exact first version. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/transactions-in-applications.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
- [statement] Setting transactionTooLargeForCacheThreshold to 1.0 disables this heuristic; it does not create more cache capacity or guarantee that an oversized transaction will complete. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
- [statement] Uncommitted changes consume WiredTiger cache. Abort abandoned or errored transactions promptly; splitting oversized work into smaller transactions can reduce cache pressure, provided the application accepts the smaller atomic units. (medium confidence) — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/transactions-and-read-write-concern · keywords: TemporarilyUnavailable and TransactionTooLargeForCache errors · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/README.md
